# Name the Warrant

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">TOULMIN</code> · Modern — analytic and scientific method · <strong>Enforced — owns a gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

the unstated warrant: grounds and claim are given, the rule connecting them never is

## What it does

`warrant` is a required field, not an optional one

## Enforced gates

These block a citation packet deterministically — no model in the loop:

- `PEIR-WARRANT-MISSING`

## Worked example

Toulmin's own case: from "Harry was born in Bermuda" to "Harry is a British subject" the step rides on an unwritten warrant — the law that a Bermudan is a British subject. Written down, a warrant can be checked or shown false; left unwritten, it just works.

## Sources

- Stephen Toulmin, The Uses of Argument (1958), ch. 3
- <https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/reasoning-defeasible/>
